plugins.name: token-reporter
plugins.description: Real-time Claude Code token usage reporter. Auto-starts a local web server showing per-request token stats with interactive charts. CLI commands: token-reporter-start, token-reporter-stop, token-reporter-status, token-reporter-auto-launch-on, token-reporter-auto-launch-off.

plugins.name: skill-keeper
plugins.description: Consistency keeper for SKILL.md and project docs. Bundles 7 methodology skills (task retrospective orchestration + pre-commit guards for both docs and SKILL.md + iterative pre-commit code review loop + subagent report verification guard + full audits for both docs and SKILL.md), and ships /skill-keeper-welcome as a progressive guide that helps you derive project-specific variants via skill-creator.

plugins.name: release-creator
plugins.description: Meta-skill derivation plugin for project-specific release workflows. Ships /release-creator-welcome — a progressive guide that helps you derive a tailored release skill for your repo (ecosystem / philosophy / packaging-and-tag / exhaustive dimensions) via skill-creator. The plugin itself performs no releases; the derived skill does.
